== Description ==

[[Ryan Jellison]] (left, grey “SUMMER LEAGUE” sweatshirt, glasses, looking at cards) and [[Vikram Bali]] (right, black “I’M IN!!!” hoodie, glasses, dark hair, looking at a phone) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
